name: [PRESTIGE SHOP] Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental
desc:
Become the Honored One.

Train, fight cursed spirits, and evolve from a weak sorcerer into an unstoppable anomaly in this Jujutsu-inspired Incremental RPG.

Start small… then break the system.

🔥 WHAT YOU DO

Train to generate insane Cursed Energy

Unlock powerful techniques and awaken your potential

Hunt cursed spirits through missions and story arcs

Roll legendary clans and abilities

Defeat bosses and collect cursed tools

Climb global leaderboards and prove you're built different

⚡ CORE FEATURES

Infinite progression — no caps, only growth

7 story arcs including Shibuya-scale battles

Clan & Technique gacha system

Boss raids with rare drops

Visible power progression and aura upgrades

👑 You don’t start as the strongest.
You become it.
